senses.definition: sound of any kind (especially unintelligible or dissonant sound)
examples: they heard indistinct noises of people talking
during the firework display that ended the gala the noise reached 98 decibels

senses.definition: the auditory experience of sound that lacks musical quality; sound that is a disagreeable auditory experience
examples: modern music is just noise to me

senses.definition: electrical or acoustic activity that can disturb communication
a loud outcry of protest or complaint
examples: the announcement of the election recount caused a lot of noise
whatever it was, he didn't like it and he was going to let them know by making as loud a noise as he could

senses.definition: incomprehensibility resulting from irrelevant information or meaningless facts or remarks
examples: all the noise in his speech concealed the fact that he didn't have anything to say

senses.definition: the quality of lacking any predictable order or plan
emit a noise
the condition of being noisy (as in a communication channel)
the amplitude level of the undesired background noise
annoying and potentially harmful environmental noise
making no sound
examples: th' inaudible and noiseless foot of time

senses.definition: without a sound
examples: he stood up soundlessly and speechlessly and glided across the hallway and through a door

senses.definition: the property of making no noise
a device (such as a clapper or bell or horn) used to make a loud noise at a celebration
with much noise or loud and unpleasant sound
the auditory effect characterized by loud and constant noise
causing or able to cause nausea
offensively malodorous
the quality of being noxious
full of or characterized by loud and nonmusical sounds
attracting attention by showiness or bright colors
